name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.175.0 — A wireframe now carries no styles of its own: it links only the three named stylesheet layers — the shared register, the shared kit, and the project's own kit — and a project's own vocabulary lives in that one file, which may not redefine or outgrow the shared kit it extends. Every design-atlas.js check run over a resolved project kit now prints its size against the shared kit's own, its rules used on exactly one screen, and its layout share — the proportion of its rules that are pure layout rather than styling, the number a deferred component-kit decision reads. 7.174.0 — Review close re-stamps the build ledger row's deviations count from the sidecar's final entry count. The build driver writes that count at COMMIT, so a sidecar restated into countable bullets afterwards left the row permanently under-reporting (specs/20260912/14 recorded 0 against two real entries); the count is only final once the fold happens, which is the close. The correction rewrites the last build row for that spec in place, touching only the number, and prints itself once in the step that follows the close. 7.173.0 — The design review page's whole-product waiting line is fixed on three counts: the singular now reads "1 whole-product note still blocks sign-off" (the verb inflects with the count, in the server render, the in-page recount, and the chrome mock alike); the line is now served hidden whenever whole-product notes are open rather than omitted while the journey still has its own open items, so resolving that last scoped note reveals the warning in place instead of silently enabling sign-off until a reload; and five tests now pin the served shown/hidden/absent states and recount()'s show, hide and text branches, replacing the zero live coverage left behind when specs/20260912/07's cases expired at close.
